issues.desc: Background says the S1 tooling was merged via B-047f, but B-047f is currently in INIT_CHECK phase, not DONE/merged. The corrected code exists on the B-047f branch (commit 75b51f124) but has not been merged to main. This does not affect the validity of the docs amendment itself -- the mathematical correction stands regardless -- but the background prose is factually inaccurate about the merge status.

background.md Key Insights states "The merged S1 tooling (experiments/experience-ablation/sample-size.mjs pilotFreezeCheck) already implements the corrected rule" but story B-047f is in INIT_CHECK phase (not merged to main); git show HEAD:experiments/experience-ablation/sample-size.mjs confirms the file does not exist in the main branch. The word "merged" is a factual inaccuracy — should say "committed in branch B-047f" or similar.

background.md Key Insights uses the abbreviation "mde" (in "n(baseline, mde)" and "baseline - mde/2") without expanding it on first appearance. Standard statistics term, but not defined in the background text.
